scripts.build: npm run build -w @threadle/web && npm run build -w @threadle/workflows-web && npm run build -w threadle
scripts.test: npm run check:boundary && npm run test -w @threadle/core -w @threadle/workflows-server -w threadle -w @threadle/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.typecheck:server: for p in shared workflows-shared core workflows-server server; do (cd packages/$p && tsc --noEmit -p .) || exit 1; done
